q5.redrive_policy: The I4 queue is aws_sqs_queue.commentary_done (name from NAMES.json commentary_ready_queue). Its redrive_policy sends to aws_sqs_queue.commentary_done_dlq with maxReceiveCount 3 (commentary.tf:166-169). Its visibility timeout is 1800 s (:164) and its retention 345600 s (:163). The DLQ retains for 1209600 s (:156). The resident's receive sets VisibilityTimeout=900 on each call (resident_worker.py:1036).
q5.redrive_would: The same body goes back through poll_package_once (resident_worker.py:1035-1053) into handle_commentary_ready. Nothing is written before the read at opal_packager.py:187, so the redrive would reach the same repository.py:392 refusal and the message would return to the DLQ, until the resident wires ANALYSIS_COMMENTARY. It would also meet current_authority.py:115 (ACTOR_NOT_FOUND) if the owner's users row is still absent. After both are fixed, the redrive renders or finds the PDF (opal_packager.py:184-186) and attaches (:227-229).
q5.who_may_redrive: No source names an actor. commentary.tf:113-114 calls the DLQ a durable place a person reads. No event-source mapping or consumer on commentary_done_dlq or commentary_ready_dlq exists in infra/aws/terraform or infra/aws/lambda (git grep at base lists only the queue definitions). The IAM principal for an SQS move-message task is not in this repository. The CTO rules.

The resident's ArtifactRepository is built with the families of irpt-x10-v1 plus irpt-ycdgen-research-v1 only (resident_installed.py:392), and ANALYSIS_COMMENTARY is registered only under irpt-anlreq-x10-v1 (registry :108). The enum has no value for a registry refusal, so the cause is UNDETERMINED.
